concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-adyen-docs-marketplaces-custom-payouts-configure-settlement-delay]] — 2026-09-15 Marketplace Configuration API guide for per-balance-account settlement-delay override, 1-day approval and managed-schedule limits, plus conditional closing-time preservation.
warnings: Previously configured non-default salesDayClosingTime must be included on balance-account update or it resets to 00:00 (raw lines 45–46).
Configuration response/webhooks do not prove settlement or payout execution.
